note: Reviewer names omitted. Order is the Play page default, not by date. Not a complete set. In this sample 86 of 135 reviews are 1 or 2 stars (64%); the shown order is the page's default, so these counts are not the app's overall rating.

reviews.text: The app is missing basic functionality. A simple notification when the device drops below 20% battery level. The latency between the device and the app is bad. The app gained 10% more battery power when the device was removed from the charger and waited 45 minutes to display the correct location. I am concerned that the device will not perform as advertised when there is an actual emergency. After reading the reviews, I will say that if my mom falls & it fails to call, there will be a lawsuit.

Edit: changing to 1 star. The app is useless. Location monitoring does not work. I hope MG will find the location if the button is pressed, but it does not show real time updates for location. When it does show a location it is never correct. The Lively app is much better at location monitoring. Other features in the app don't work either (the history bar charts for example). Might have made a mistake switching from Lively to Medical Guardian.

Zero stars. App doesn't work. Errors when trying to add information into any field. Won't save info even if I can get past errors. Absolutely useless. I'm going to cancel the plan and move to another system. If the app is this error ridden, I can't trust the service to work if there is an actual need.

I setup a device for my mother in law, and it has been difficult ever since. The billing should come to me and the device is with her. But they have it the other way around in their system, called their customer sevice multiple times and the people were helpful but ultimately whatever system they use has issues and overwrites the corrected information back to the incorrect version. Very very frustrating. I would not recommend and will likely cancel this service if I cannot get this resolved.

My mother has fallen twice and the fall detection didn't work either time. I'm not impressed with the app or the services. I truly hope that the equipment works better than the app. The step counter barely works. Sometimes it allows you to review previous days, sometimes it does not. It labels steps as today but it looks suspiciously like yesterday's counts. Very limited and unimpressive.

This app is not working at all!! You stored the billing though! Of course that carried thru. We cannot trust this device if we can't monitor 89 yr old with medical issues. I guess it's time to cancel and look for a better and actually reliable safety net! fix this damn app! You are putting people at risk and should be liable should something happen to them.

Fall detection never alerted me after my Mother had fallen two different times. The GPS "updates"once per hour and is NOT accurate. The step counter doesn't work. It either registers "zero" or once it gave me some outlandish number that even I have never done in one day. I definitely wouldn't rely on it. Highly disappointed for what I paid for the system to ensure my Mom's safety!

I hope the emergency response will be OK, because the app is terrible. I should be able to stay logged in and have correct info on my mother's location. I called and was told by a human my mom's correct location, but to log out and back on to "re-sync" the app. I shouldn't have to do that every time I want to check on my mom, especially for the price.
